entities.summary: Muhammad Taqi Usmani SI, OI, is a Pakistani Islamic jurist and leading scholar of the Qur'an, Hadith, Islamic law, Islamic economics, and comparative religion. He was a member of the Council of Islamic Ideology from 1977 to 1981, a judge of the Federal Shariat Court from 1981 to 1982, and a judge in the Shariat Appellate Bench of the Supreme Court of Pakistan from 1982 to 2002. In 2020, he was selected as the most influential Muslim personality in the world. He is considered a leading intellectual of the contemporary Deobandi movement, and his opinions and fatwas are widely accepted by Deobandi scholars and institutions worldwide, including the Darul Uloom Deoband in India.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: As a leading scholar of Islamic law and comparative religion, Muhammad Taqi Usmani's opinions and fatwas have had significant regional impact in Pakistan and globally among Deobandi scholars. His influence has shaped the contemporary Deobandi movement.
